prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: a SINGLE character's transparent pixel RPG animation atlas. Use supplied image ONLY as art direction and costume identity reference. Draw exactly ONE specified adult fantasy character in EIGHT poses, arranged on a perfectly equal FOUR-COLUMN TWO-ROW grid, left-to-right then top-to-bottom. IMPORTANT: exactly 8 same character images, not a selection sheet with 8 different characters. No text or numbers, no grid lines, no background color; genuinely transparent background. Each grid cell same width and height, character centered with identical scale and baseline; all hair, weapons, cloaks and effects completely inside its own cell with generous 12 percent padding. Full body visible in every pose. Large-head compact 3-head-tall CHIBI pixel game sprites, preserve charming handsome or beautiful faces. Clear deliberately large square pixel blocks, staircase contours, clustered limited-palette shading; no smooth illustration, no speckled noise. Same outfit, hair, face, weapon in all 8 cells. Keep held weapon visible throughout, no extra limbs or duplicated weapons. Relative face orientation always mostly facing right; ground baseline same. Pose order mandatory: top row 1 relaxed idle eyes open; 2 relaxed idle eyes closed blinking with subtly lifted chest and swaying hair; 3 diagonal swinging / forceful casting pose; 4 forward thrust / projectile-release pose. Bottom row 5 overhead striking / raised staff casting pose; 6 lateral sweep / sweeping magic-cast pose; 7 critical charge-up pose braced legs weapon back; 8 critical impact pose weapon thrust forward with tiny contained matching pixel energy accents. For archers: 3 draw bow diagonally, 4 release arrow forward, 5 raise bow upward, 6 sideways rapid arrow release; keep recognizable bow in each. For priests/mages: vary hand/staff/book and stance for four distinct spell casting poses. Knights and berserkers: four visibly different weapon and limb poses. EIGHT genuine individually drawn poses, equal cell size, stable scale, transparent no floor shadows. No large external effects. No giant portrait. Output wide animation sheet, prefer 1536 by 1024.
